claims.sourceText: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base: The First Century, History Office, Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Air Force Materiel Command, 2015, Appendix B, p. 44. https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-D301-PURL-gpo111353/pdf/GOVPUB-D301-PURL-gpo111353.pdf
claims.text: The Air Force's own base history lists the installation commanders in sequence: 'Colonel Glen McClernon August 1962 / Colonel Arthur E. Exon August 1964 / Colonel Jowell C. Wise December 1965'. Exon held the post as a colonel, from August 1964, and was succeeded in December 1965.

claims.sourceText: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base: The First Century, 2015, searched in full. https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-D301-PURL-gpo111353/pdf/GOVPUB-D301-PURL-gpo111353.pdf
claims.text: The same 76-page installation history names Exon in no other place and records nothing about him beyond the appendix entry.

edges.label: Held the command as a Colonel, per the Air Force's own commander table
edges.note: He held the command as a United States Air Force officer, listed as a colonel in the Air Force's own installation-commander table.

edges.label: Installation commander, August 1964 to December 1965
edges.note: Exon was the installation commander of Wright-Patterson Air Force Base from August 1964 to December 1965 per the base's own published history.
